summary: News Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing daily repurchase activity under its $1 billion stock buyback program, reporting transactions on the ASX. The program covers Class A and Class B common stock. No price per share or premium is specified; repurchases are open-market. The board previously authorized the program; no advisor named. The filing complies with ASX disclosure rules. The repurchase reduces share count and supports EPS. Watch for pace of buyback and market conditions; no risk-arb spread as this is an issuer capital return, not a tender offer.
